title: crypto2dev: SHA-2 and SHA-3 hash callbacks
description: Implement CryptoCb streaming hash handlers for SHA-256, SHA-384, SHA-512, SHA3-256, SHA3-384, SHA3-512. Lifecycle: on Init callback, acquire OPERATION fd from pool, call INIT('sha256' etc.), store fd in hash->devCtx. On Update, write() data to fd. On Final, FINALIZE then read() digest, release fd to pool. On Free (WC_ALGO_TYPE_FREE), release fd if not yet finalized (abort path). Map wolfSSL wc_HashType values to crypto2dev algo strings. SHA-1 and SHA-224: return CRYPTOCB_UNAVAILABLE (not in crypto2dev), fall back to software.
notes: Requires WOLF_CRYPTO_CB_FREE for the abort path (hash object freed before Final called). devCtx on wc_Sha256/wc_Sha384/wc_Sha512 structs holds the fd. Must handle the case where Init is called multiple times (re-init: release old fd, acquire new one).
